optional_source_scope: These files license source-qualified descriptions of configured priority rules. A lower-priority navigation input is inhibited when a corresponding lock is active; equal/higher-priority inputs may remain eligible. Static configuration alone does not prove deployed node wiring, observed lock activation, applied controller output, physical motion, or a unique physical cause of task failure. No per-episode runtime configuration/wiring attestation is supplied in this development extension. Do not infer completed task causation from an unobserved source condition.

required_units.requirement: Communicate the reported navigation software succeeded outcome; do not infer physical arrival.

scope_limits: Software status does not alone prove physical goal completion.
Commands are commands; odometry estimates motion over its recorded samples.
Static controller source licenses configured rules, not observed deployment or unique causation.
Unavailable channels remain unknown; no zero/false replacement.
A clearing request does not establish completed clearing.
